about_the_game:
The stage is set, the spotlight's on... and Fredo Bargains is ready to play! Meet Fredo, a fast-talking impresario cat and agent to the stars, who always has a trick (or contract) up his sleeve. Great Aria Games are starting soon, and Fredo Bargains is counting on you to win first prize! You will need to recruit the best and brightest if you want to crush the competition. Travel across the worlds of Aria, find the best talent, and put together an ace team to win the Games! Features:

  • A new playable character - Take control of Fredo Bargains, the charismatic and cunning impresario cat.

  • 6 brand-new story chapters - Explore Altabianca, Ashanul, and more to recruit the best team and win the Great Aria Games.

  • More choices, more chaos - Engage in new roleplaying scenarios filled with clever trades, double-crosses, and theatrical flair.
